w: After his morning puja, Swamishri performed pujan of the murtis for the Swaminarayan Kutir Mandir in Kakadkuva village. Swamishri also performed Bhumi-pujan of the soil for the new mandirs in the villages of Nalimdhani, Kurgam, Baroliya and Balvada.
In the evening assembly, volunteers of the Bal Mandal, Rajkot, performed an inspiring drama 'Tamso ma jyotir gamay'. Then Swamishri blessed the assembly.
In the evening satsang assembly, the Collector and Municipal Commissioner of Junagadh Shri Pathak felicitated Swamishri with a citation of honor.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
233 women devotees fasted for 83 hours to please Swamishri.
105 women devotees of Jamnagar had fasted for Swamishri's continuing good health.
32 men and women devotees of Khijadiya village, 11 devotees from Bareja and 15 devotees from Laiyara village had pilgrimaged by foot to Bhadra.

Two satsangi schoolboys, Mayur and Kirtan, prayed to Swamishri, “Swami, bless us so that we may pass in our exams.” Swamishri placed his hands on their heads and replied, “Be a good devotee while you grow up. Study properly. Don’t get spoilt after growing up. Do puja, rosary, tilak-chandlo daily and come to the mandir regularly.”
Swamishri blessed them to pass in their life.
About 300 selected students of BAPS Chhatralays in Gujarat assembled for a three-day shibir. Swamishri and senior sadhus blessed and guided the youths through speeches and question-answer sessions.

During personal darshan, a student told his sad story: "My father has recently passed away to Akshardham. I have seven uncles. Until now everything was run jointly. My father did tailoring work and got all the brothers married, but after my father went to Akshardham, all the uncles have cut off relations with us. My mother is always under tension."
Lovingly stroking the student's head, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "One who has no one has God. So keep patience, let the days pass and work hard. God will make everything good."

A youth had come to Pramukh Swami Maharaj with his plan. Swamishri looked over this plan for expanding the business. At the end he asked, "You have not taken up any addiction, have you?" At this the youth's business partner said that sometimes, when he goes out for business, he eats meat.

Swamishri immediately said, "If we go to meet someone and they give us poison, do we eat it? In the same way, this too should not be eaten. The business will happen anyway; it will happen by God's support. What would you call it if we ate someone's children? How can we torment anyone? So do satsang properly and give up eating meat. Animals too have a right to live. Animals depend on us and we depend on animals. Both are bound to each other. So never eat meat."
The youth accepted Swamishri's advice with reverence and took a vow.

Amrutatanay Swami, who lives in Himmatnagar, said, "We live in Himmatnagar (the town of courage), but many times our courage runs out."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj immediately said, "If courage runs out, how can satsang happen? In everything you talk of courage, courage, so how can courage run out? Keep the strength of God and the Sant, and you will not become weak."

Many times, while travelling in tribal areas and nurturing satsang, it may happen that patience runs out. Then Swamishri inspires the sadhus with strengthening words and makes them enthusiastic again.
